name: me.proton.core.notification.presentation.ui.NotificationPermissionActivity
description: Proton AG's Proton Core Android SDK opens this Activity when the app asks the user to enable notifications. It explains the request when needed, launches Android's notification-permission prompt, and returns the user's choice.
disableEffect: If disabled, this in-app flow cannot request notification permission, so app notifications may not be enabled from the app.
